model_conventions.formal_meaning: The two labelled firms are each first with probability one half, independently of candidate values, ranking draws, and strategy randomization. Thus a labelled firm's ex-ante payoff is the arithmetic mean of its first-mover payoff and the payoff obtained when the other firm moves first.

Equations (4) and (5), and the Lean game semantics, use an unweighted sum or division by two, which is valid only for a uniform arrival order. Treating that weight as implied by the word random would smuggle a material model choice into the source result.
